summary: Completed Module 05 Context exercise on production error sanitization, security boundaries, and log correlation.
evidence: Defined the HTTP 500 response contract: return safe generic detail and request_id, strictly forbidding stack traces, internal file paths, database credentials, SQL statements, and secrets.
Identified the unique Request ID (Correlation ID) as the single essential tracing token returned to clients to enable instant pinpointing of backend diagnostic logs during production incidents.
